title: Recommitment Propensity Lab - Tracker
summary: Experimental tracker to run an ARR-weighted recommitment propensity lab. Purpose: prioritize high-leverage accounts for proactive playbooks ahead of staggered contract windows. Uses hybrid score (health + usage trend + exec engagement) to map probability tiers and next steps.
metrics_snapshot:
Total accounts in sheet: 12
Total ARR (unweighted): $4,760,000
Weighted expected ARR (sum ARR * probability): $3,152,000
Average probability: 66%
High-priority weighted ARR (>80% prob): $1,100,000
playbook_snippets: Green tier (>85%): Light-touch renewal email + auto-canary pricing offer; Amber (50-85%): 1:1 TAM outreach, deployment review, pilot ROI summary; Red (<50%): CSM + Solutions deep-dive, executive sponsor briefing, commercial sweetener with timebox.
